author: Atomic Shrimp
description:
Join me at Chiswell - the northern end of the Isle of Portland, Dorset (UK) at the arrival of Storm Austen, with the raging sea heaped up upon itself and the roar of the wind and waves on the Chesil Beach stones.  You might notice a bit of camera shake on this one as I had to brace myself against the relentless wind.

Slow TV isn't for everyone - nothing is scripted here - no narration or music - nothing much happens, except by natural chance, and that's OK - there are no sudden loud noises in this video and no midroll ads. Mostly you will just hear the wind, waves and occasional other natural sounds.  You may also occasionally hear the faraway background sounds of human activity, but don't think on that for now - just enjoy this moment looking at the awesome force of nature.
title: Slow TV - Storm Austen at Chesil Beach
